$comment: META-2 source-comment hygiene policy. Loaded by scripts/check-no-workflow-context.mjs at runtime. Adding a new pattern: append to `patterns[]` + update docs/runbook/meta-2-enforcement.md + reference the binding D-number / META-N. Each pattern has: rule (kebab-case identifier), regex (string, will be `new RegExp(value, flags)`), flags (string, typically 'i' for case-insensitive), message (one-line fix guidance).

escape_hatch.description: Inline annotation that suppresses the gate on the SAME line. Format: `// META-2-allow: <one-line rationale>`. Use sparingly + only when the matched substring is legitimate (e.g., a vendor SKU like 'M3' that happens to match the M-number pattern). The rationale is required for git-blame audit traceability.

patterns.message: Replace M-number (M1, M1.5, M3, etc.) with a permanent doc ref (D-number, ADR, RFC).
Replace Round-N audit ref with the canonical D-number or ADR-NNNN.
Replace Wave-N sprint ref with a permanent doc ref (D-number, ADR-NNNN).
Replace Cluster-N taxonomy ref with a permanent doc ref (D-number, ADR-NNNN).
Replace "this sprint" / "next sprint" with a milestone-neutral phrasing.
Replace "the audit found" with a permanent doc ref.
Replace Commit N ref with a permanent doc ref (D-number, ADR-NNNN).
Replace `@quilty/<role>-reviewer` agent-name ref with a generic reviewer mention.
Replace JIRA-NNN ticket ref with a permanent doc ref. Tickets outlive their utility; source comments should reference D-numbers or ADRs.

Replace QLY-NNN Linear ticket ref with a permanent doc ref. Tickets outlive their utility; source comments should reference D-numbers or ADRs. (The Linear pattern is scoped to the Quilty project key `QLY-` so it does not false-positive on legitimate prefixes like ADR-, RFC-, etc. If a future contributor adds a new Linear project key, append it here as a separate rule.)
Replace GH-NNN issue ref with a permanent doc ref. GitHub issue numbers drift across repos / migrations; source comments should reference D-numbers or ADRs.
